## Hypothesis

The VWAP overnight grinder edge can be captured by analyzing the premarket trading activity and identifying potential setups for the next trading day. The hypothesis is that the grinder's performance can be improved by incorporating out-of-sample testing to validate the strategy's effectiveness in unseen market conditions.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves using a combination of technical indicators, such as the VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price) and the RSI (Relative Strength Index), to identify potential trading opportunities in the premarket session. The strategy will then use a set of predefined rules to determine the optimal entry and exit points for each trade.
